thread:
sam.design: Quick design check — I pushed a small prototype for the prompt-sets test-suite detail view. Can we iterate on the diff panel ordering?

maria.pm: thanks! link?

sam.design: https://redwood/intern/prototypes/prompt-evals/diff-panel v1 (comments in the canvas). TL;DR: current layout is list on the left, diff on the right. proposal is to flip by default for regression-first workflows.

alex.research: saw it. My worry: flipping by default hides the test metadata (source prompt, tags) behind a secondary tab. We lose context when triaging regressions.

maria.pm: context is important for reviewers who only approve/deny changes. maybe show a compact metadata row above the diff?

devon.frontend: compact metadata row is doable. main constraints: we need to keep keyboard nav stable (j/k to move tests) and ensure focus doesn't jump when diffs load.

li.accessibility: also need aria-live for diff summaries so screen reader users get notified when a new diff is shown. current prototype doesn't announce anything.

sam.design: good call. propose: left = list, top of diff pane = compact metadata (prompt name, run id, tags), below that diff. flip option as a user preference (persisted).

devon.frontend: implementable. one question on copy: current CTA says `Approve change` or `Reject`. legal asked to avoid “reject” as it's harsh. suggestions?

maria.pm: what about `Confirm` / `Flag as issue`? or `Mark as expected` / `Mark as unexpected`?

alex.research: prefer language that maps to test semantics. `Mark as expected` / `Mark as regression` is very explicit.

li.accessibility: also ensure color + icon not rely on color only. Add text labels and aria-pressed on the toggle.

devon.frontend: noted. sample markup for toggle we can use:

```
<button aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Mark as expected" class="btn-approve">Mark as expected</button>
<button aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Mark as regression" class="btn-flag">Mark as regression</button>
```

sam.design: nice. can we shorten primary to `Mark expected`? fits better in narrow panes.

maria.pm: agree. also add tooltip `Use when the change is intended or acceptable` to reduce mistakes.

devon.frontend: will add tooltip and update keyboard shortcuts: `m` for mark expected, `f` for flag. bulk keyboard: `shift+m` approves visible selection. need QA signoff.

qa-bot: Test run 3422 completed — 8 regressions detected. Queueing for triage in "Prompt Eval" board.

sam.design: one more a11y nit — focus ring for approve buttons currently is very subtle on mac safari. li, can you propose a 3px outline or different system color?

li.accessibility: recommend `outline: 3px solid Highlight` fallback to `#005fcc`. also ensure contrast for tooltips >= 4.5.

maria.pm: action items: 1) devon implement compact metadata row + flipped preference toggle, 2) copy update to `Mark expected` / `Mark regression`, tooltip copy, 3) a11y changes from li, 4) add aria-live diff summary. Can we aim for Friday PR?

devon.frontend: I can target Friday EOD. will open PR with screenshots and keyboard test notes.

sam.design: perfect. leaving a couple inline comments on the prototype about spacing and microcopy. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

alex.research: quick follow-up — can we add a tiny diff summary line (e.g., `tokens changed: +3`) to the metadata row? helps fast triage.

maria.pm: love that. devon add it to the API payload if not present.

devon.frontend: noted. if API can't supply, we'll compute a simple token delta client-side as fallback.

sam.design: great. closing thread once PR lands.
